title: Things to Be Kept in Mind for Good Memory

blocks.x: In Section Two of this book, I have referred to a prayer to be performed for gaining good memory.
Finally, it is advised to avoid doing things that bring about oblivion and stupor, such as:

(1) eating sour apple, green coriander, cheese, and leftover of rats, (2) urinating in still water, (3) reading the tablets on graves, (4) walking between two women (for men), (5) throwing alive lice on the ground, (6) abandoning nail trimming, (7) forsaking taking a nap, (8) committing acts of disobedience frequently, (9) engaging oneself with grievances and grumbles about this-worldly affairs, (10) being excessively busy, (11) looking at crucified persons, and (12) passing among a convoy of camels.
